title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical errors. There is a minor notational overload: σ denotes both the origin map Ã → S and (subscripted) the involution σ_Ã.

ideas.what: Dual graph of a nodal curve: vertices are irreducible components, edges are double points, oriented edges are branches at the nodes, encoded by an origin map and a free involution.
ideas.modern_name: Dual graph of a stable curve; graph with half-edges / Serre graph
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore in degeneration theory (Deligne–Mumford 1969 era); graph formalism after Serre, Trees (1977); half-edge formalism Kontsevich, Getzler–Kapranov
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) discusses the stratification at infinity of M_{g,ν} by combinatorial type, but not this explicit formalism (unsure)

ideas.what: Marked points recorded as an extra map I → S (legs attached to vertices), so the graph depends on the pair (\hat X, I) rather than on \hat X alone.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful but standard definition of the dual graph with legs of a marked nodal curve, using the half-edge/Serre formalism. It is well established in the literature; at most it is of historical interest as Grothendieck's own formulation.

'S est l'ens des sommets' is the abbreviation 'ens.' (ensemble) in both occurrences; the transcription is fine.
